title: Samael's Might&Magic
description: Level up, get new gear and liberate the dimensions!
body:
Samael's Might&Magic is a modpack that combines adventure, magic and technology. 

You can explore up to eight universes that bring on many challaging bosses, creatures and structures. 

--------------------------------

The story is set after the Holy War between heaven and hell, you were summoned here by something or someone to liberate the decimated worlds that are occupied by the Lords.
